about: Elco Ltd. operates in the construction, infrastructure, consumer electronics, telecommunications, entertainment, and real estate sectors in Israel and internationally. It operates through Electra; Electra Consumer Products; Electra Real Estate; Electra Power; and Others segments. The company develops, constructs, operates, manages, and maintains various projects; installs and provides services for central air-conditioning systems, elevators, sanitation, and infrastructure; executes and constructs national infrastructure facilities; offers security and protection, electricity and piping, public
